newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-TRANSVAAL 88-4 AT LUNCH AGAINST NATAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TRANSVAAL 88-4 AT LUNCH AGAINST NATAL.

text.p: Transvaal were 88 for four from 36 overs at lunch, needing 408 to beat Natal in their four- day Supersport Series match in Johannesburg on Monday.
Scores: Natal 407 (Jonty Rhodes 137, Clive Eksteen 5-83) and 241-8 declared (Clive Eksteen 4-75), Transvaal 241 (Ken Rutherford 88, Lance Klusener 4-61, Shaun Pollock 4-58) and 88-4.
